newsitem.title: CHINA: China consumer market seen up 12.3 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China consumer market seen up 12.3 pct in 1997.

text.p: China's consumer market was expected to rise by an inflation-adjusted 12.3 percent in 1997, with retail sales expected to hit 2,818 billion yuan, the Financial News said on Sunday.
It forecast urban incomes would rise by 8.5 percent in 1997 before adjustment for inflation, and rural incomes were expected to climb 11.4 percent.
Urban per capita incomes for the first half of the year rose by an inflation-adjusted 2.2 percent to 2,680 yuan, while rural per capita income for the first half rose a real 3.3 percent to 980 yuan.
Growth in urban incomes was seen to stall because of stagnating wages, while rural incomes would rise as farmers adjusted the types of crops they grew, the newspaper said.
